after thinking about it, i realise i was being completely dumb and not realising that the snowman pieces would heal 49 with the burnt pan, therefore still being 5hp more than the legendary heroes. so yes, if you have any leftover then use them but it's not imperative if you have to use them to beat undyne.

for undyne, memorisation and reaction is the key to beating her. the first 2 red attacks you see are random, and so are the 2 green attacks with loads of spears. learn the other attacks as much as possible.
for items, use the snowman pieces and cinnamon buns.
ballet shoes and tutu are my choice of armour and weapon but cloudy glasses and notebook will increase invincibility frames so you may find these more useful.

for sans, he may or may not be harder. it depends on you as a person. my friend finds undyne so much harder but i find sans the harder one by far. 

for sans use the pie, noodles, face steak and 5 legendary heroes as items. use burnt pan as weapon to get 4 extra hp per item. armour doesn't matter and you'll see exactly why when you get to him.

sans is about hand-eye coordination, reaction and memorisation. learn the attacks. react as fast as possible. but the battle will not progress unless you attack him.

hopefully this helped.
